sources.title: Claude Opus 5.5 fast mode 结束研究预览并移除等待名单 / Opus 5.5 fast mode in the Claude Platform is no longer in research preview, and we’ve removed the waitlist!
sources.title_zh: Claude Opus 5.5 fast mode 结束研究预览并移除等待名单
sources.title_en: Opus 5.5 fast mode in the Claude Platform is no longer in research preview, and we’ve removed the waitlist!
sources.title_original: Opus 5.5 fast mode in the Claude Platform is no longer in research preview, and we’ve removed the waitlist!
sources.summary: Anthropic 宣布 Claude 平台上的 Opus 5.5 fast mode 不再处于研究预览阶段，并已移除等待名单。该模式速度最高提升 2.5 倍，定价为 $8 / $40 per million tokens；现已登陆 Microsoft Foundry（Azure 托管），Google Cloud 即将支持。Claude Code 中的 fast mode 保持不变，消耗额外 usage credits。文档见 https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/build-with-claude/fast-mode
sources.recommend_reason_zh: 这条更新称 Claude Platform 的 Opus 5.5 fast mode 已结束 research preview 并取消 waitlist，开发者可直接使用，速度最高提升 2.5 倍，价格为 $8 / $40 每百万 tokens，且已在 Microsoft Foundry（Hosted on Azure）上线，Google Cloud 即将支持。

en.summary: Anthropic says Opus 5.5 fast mode on the Claude platform is out of research preview, and the waitlist has been removed. The mode is up to 2.5x faster, priced at $8 / $40 per million tokens; it's now available in Microsoft Foundry (Azure-hosted), with Google Cloud support coming soon. en.title: Kling 4.0 drops late at night: the author puts its 30-second one-take and omni-reference performance to the test.
en.summary: Kling AI officially launched its Kling 4.0 video model early this morning. After burning through tens of thousands of credits in hands-on testing, the author found solid gains in large-scale motion, complex action transitions, and all-purpose reference controllability. It supports up to 30-second one-take generation, and first/last frame reference has been expanded to multi-frame reference of up to 10 frames; 1080P 30 seconds costs about 450 credits, while 720P 20 seconds on Kling 4.0 Flash costs only 120 credits. The author recommends prototyping with Flash first, then using the full version for final output. The 10-bit 4K HDR output spec is not yet live.
en.reason: Kling 4.0 launched with 30-second one-shot generation and multi-frame references, after burning tens of thousands of credits the author finds stronger physics and action, recommending 120-credit 720P 20-second Kling 4.0 Flash drafts before 450-credit 1080P 30-second finals.

sources.summary: Anthropic在面向潜在投资者的会议上公布Q3营收168亿美元，环比增长约45%，但明显低于Q2超140%的增速。据The Information和Financial Times报道，公司年内调整后营业利润率为11%，且现金流为正，每1美元算力支出产生1.70美元收入。部分投资者对其营收数字失望，预计IPO估值可能降至1.5万亿美元以下，低于此前讨论的2万亿美元。
sources.recommend_reason_zh: 这篇值得读：Anthropic第三季度营收$16.8B、环比增45%，远低于Q2的140%；11月IPO前，部分投资者预期其估值跌破$1.5万亿。

en.summary: At a meeting with potential investors, Anthropic reported Q3 revenue of $16.8 billion, up about 45% quarter over quarter but well below Q2’s over 140% growth. According to The Information and Financial Times, its adjusted operating margin for the year is 11%, with positive cash flow and every $1 of compute spending generating $1.70 in revenue. Some investors were disappointed with its revenue figures and expect an IPO valuation that could fall below $1.5 trillion, down from the $2 trillion previously discussed.
en.reason: Anthropic's third-quarter revenue reached $16.8 billion, up 45 percent but far below Q2's 140 percent surge, as some investors expect its valuation to fall below $1.5 trillion ahead of a November IPO.
